testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: Every finite valid ClayCode type structure must terminate independently of host interpreter stack limits; cycles must return a typed denial rather than host failure.
testable_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Raising the Python recursion limit is an equivalent semantic repair.
testable_hypotheses.test: Generate bounded acyclic and cyclic alias graphs across depths, branching and parameter nesting on multiple Python recursion limits and compare ClayCode verdicts.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: Any finite admitted graph changes verdict solely with host recursion limit, or any cycle escapes typed denial.

testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: Semantic frontier measurements remain stable only when corpus membership is explicit, byte-bound and separate from discovery/parser acceptance.
testable_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: All discovered .clay files that parse can safely join the frontier automatically.
testable_hypotheses.test: Add parseable and unparseable unauthorized sources, rename authorized sources and mutate the reference tree; require separate discovered/authorized/excluded/unclassified accounting and fail-closed drift.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: An unauthorized discovered file changes semantic frontier counts without an authority event, or an authorized byte disappears without gate failure.

testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: A rollback-resistant lineage witness requires authenticated live read, provider-side monotonicity and recoverable two-phase advancement between local checkpoint and remote witness.
testable_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Signed equality between local and remote records is sufficient.
testable_hypotheses.test: Crash before/after each local and remote write; replay caches, roll back provider state, steal mutation credentials and partition reads; require deterministic recovery or fail-closed boot.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: A stale mutually consistent pair boots, or a valid partial advance cannot recover without unsafe rollback.

testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: Red checks require typed interpretation: zero-step red is instrument state, while an executed expected-denial sentinel is valid counterevidence about an open release obligation.
testable_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: All red conclusions are equivalent failures.
testable_hypotheses.test: Bind runner, steps, decision marker, expected exit and artifact payload; compare classification with the actual semantic contract.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: A typed sentinel classification predicts the wrong gate state after replaying the same decision surface.

new_concepts.name: Authority-Discovery Membrane
new_concepts.definition: Discovery reports candidates; a separately bound authority membrane decides which artifacts may alter semantic measurements.

new_concepts.name: Witness Eclipse
new_concepts.definition: A stale local checkpoint and stale cached remote witness agree perfectly while jointly hiding a newer lineage head.

new_concepts.name: Red Verdict Type System
new_concepts.definition: Red outcomes are partitioned into no-execution instrument state, unexpected executed failure and expected fail-closed observation sentinel.

primary_sources.use: Python's recursion limit is a host-stack safety limit and is platform-dependent; domain semantics should not depend on raising it.
Signed blob verification can bind artifact digest and signer identity, but it is a separate artifact-attestation obligation from live state-lineage freshness.
Cosign bundles contain signature, certificate and transparency-log inclusion proof; bundle existence alone does not provide provider-side state anti-rollback.
